---
title: "Starting Example"
bibliography: ../references.bib
---

In this example, I apply the matrix to Ford Motor Co. 

First, I provide a map of Ford factories globally. 


```{r}
#| label: fig-ford-factories
#| fig-cap: "Global distribution of Ford manufacturing facilities"

library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
setwd("E:/matrix/")

# Ford factory locations (latitude, longitude, name)
# ford_factories <- tibble(
#     name = c("Dearborn", "Chicago", "Kansas City", "Valencia", "Cologne"),
#     lat = c(42.3134, 41.8781, 39.0997, 39.4699, 50.9413),
#     lng = c(-83.1467, -87.6298, -94.5786, -0.3763, 6.9143)
# )

ford_factories <- import("./data/firms/geocodes/F_factory_locations_geocoded.csv")

if (!"ticker" %in% names(ford_factories)) {
    ford_factories$ticker <- "F"
}

ford_factories <- ford_factories %>%
    mutate(ticker = if_else(is.na(ticker) | ticker == "", "F", ticker))

company_icons <- iconList(
    "F US" = makeIcon(
        iconUrl = "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3e/Ford_logo_flat.svg",
        iconWidth = 30,
        iconHeight = 30
    )
)

leaflet(ford_factories) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    addMarkers(
        ~longitude,
        ~latitude,
        icon = ~ company_icons[ticker],
        label = ~ paste0(facility_name, " (", ticker, ")"),
        popup = ~ paste(
            "<b>", facility_name, "</b><br>",
            "Ticker: ", ticker, "<br>",
            "Type: ", facility_type, "<br>",
            "Products: ", products, "<br>",
            "Active: ", status
        )
    )

```
